sentence: This project builds an image method that combines whole-brain spectroscopic imaging and diffusion MRI data along the corticospinal tract to assess amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
This project tries to find out how lysine methylation on proteins other than histones controls what those proteins do in cells.
This project studies genes that control how sperm and egg fit together in the fish Astyanax mexicanus.
This project builds an adeno-associated virus with engineered inverted terminal repeats to make gene therapies safer.
This project studies how imaging surveillance is used in lung cancer survivors and builds a deep learning model that predicts lung cancer recurrence.
This project uses genetic and brain data to find biological markers that sort Veterans with a psychiatric concern into different types.
This project builds gene editing tools based on DNA integrases and CRISPR nucleases to change genes in zebrafish.
This project studies how appearance related safety behaviors change within a day, what comes before them and how they affect symptoms.
This project tries to find out how neuroimmunology-mediated mechanisms in mutant gliomas could be used for therapy.
This project uses a robotic approach to test combination therapies on microdissected tumors and to run proteomics profiling of mouse and human cuboids.
This project tries to find out which genes help microbes adapt inside and outside of hosts in a host-microbe mutualism.
This project studies how high cholesterol and turbulent blood flow change a protein in blood vessel lining cells that helps cause atherosclerosis.
This project maps and probes the distributed brain network underlying visual processing using electrophysiological and computational approaches.
This project studies how antibodies in blood and the respiratory track respond to influenza infection or vaccination, and how they compare.
This project studies immunologic mechanisms in musculoskeletal and autoimmune rheumatic disease.
This project builds a platform that screens soil bacterial producers in microdroplets to find antifungals for fungal infections.
This project trains machine-learning models on images to find epileptogenic brain regions and refine surgical plans for patients with focal epilepsies.
This project uses engineered nanoparticles to deliver a regulator of smooth muscle cell function to blood vessel cells to reduce restenosis.
This project builds genomics tools that detect and map retrotransposition events in aging cells and animals.
This project provides data collection, management and analysis services for cancer research.
